title: Caja de Invención de la Bombilla de Edison: Exhibición de Museo Steampunk con Prototipo y Herramientas Históricas
prompt:
Input A is a lightbulb (world-changing invention).
Analyze the inventor (Thomas Edison), eureka moment, prototype design, and societal impact.
Style reference: steampunk-meets-modern museum aesthetic.
Goal: Wooden display box with brass hinges containing the miniature "first prototype" surrounded by inventor's tools, failed attempts, and blueprint fragments.
Rules:
- Center: tiny working-looking carbon filament lightbulb prototype
- Include inventor figurine at miniature workbench
- Surround with 10-15 period tools (glass blowers, vacuum pumps, sketches, bamboo filament samples, failed carbonized thread attempts)
- Add aged paper "patent document" visible through glass top
- Materials: dark wood, brass accents, vintage glass
- Plaque with invention name "Electric Light Bulb", inventor "Thomas Edison", patent year "1879"
Output: ONE image, 1:1 inventor's journal aesthetic
